name: algebra-solver
description: A zero-cost, Python-based algebra solver using Pyodide and SymPy with a modern Tailwind CSS UI

scripts.build: npm ci && npm run build-css && npm run build-js
scripts.build-css: npm run update-browserslist && npx tailwindcss -i css/input.css -o css/output.css --minify || echo 'TailwindCSS build failed'
scripts.build-js: npx terser js/main.js js/solver.js js/mathSolver.js --compress --mangle --output js/bundle.min.js

author: Rumsfeld
